resources.string: Made on this phone while you watch. Speech recognition and translation run offline, and the app has no internet access, so your movies never leave the device.
No movies yet. Open a video to get English subtitles for it.
%1$s is removed from the list and its subtitles are deleted, so they would be made again next time. The video file itself is not touched.
Removed from the list. Its subtitles are kept for next time.
Pick the file once more so the app may read it.
Nothing to download: every model is part of the app and works offline. This phone has %1$s GB of memory, so the app uses %2$s unless you choose another speech model in Settings.
How far ahead subtitles must be ready before playback starts. Use High Accuracy or Full Movie if your phone is slower than real time.
Bigger models are more accurate but slower. Automatic picks the best one for this phone\'s memory.
Automatic uses M2M100 with Whisper tiny and base, where it translates much better, and Whisper\'s own translation with small, which scored a little higher in tests and is faster.
This phone is 32-bit, so Whisper translates (M2M100 needs a 64-bit phone).
Automatic detection works for most films; pick the language if it is misdetected (for example Bengali).
Use only the fast CPU cores (%1$d of %2$d)
Keeps recognition off the slow power-saving cores, which would otherwise hold the fast ones back.
All cores of this phone run at the same speed, so no core is left out.

Half the threads, faster translation settings and no background work beyond the look-ahead. This also turns on by itself when the system Power Saver is on, the battery is at 15 % or less and not charging, or the phone is hot.
Pause playback while subtitles are not ready
Keep translating the whole movie in the background
Open movies in landscape full screen
Widescreen videos turn to landscape and fill the screen. The full-screen button in the player switches back to portrait.
Audio track for playback and subtitles

Everything runs on this device: audio is decoded from your video, recognised by Whisper (whisper.cpp) and translated to English, and the results are cached so a movie is never processed twice. The app has no internet permission, so nothing is uploaded or downloaded.
whisper.cpp and CTranslate2 run on the phone\'s processor, using its %1$s instructions.
whisper.cpp and CTranslate2 run on the phone\'s processor.
AC-3, E-AC-3, DTS and TrueHD through FFmpeg %1$s, used only when the phone has no decoder of its own. These libraries are replaceable; see the FFmpeg section of the notices.
Not included in this build, so AC-3 and DTS play only if the phone decodes them.
